This Document outlines the 
maintenance procedures 
P1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.

The hydrogen producing unit function is to produce hydrogen gas by 
electrical analysis to demi-water.

The Hydrogen Production Unit consists of:: one hydrogen gas 
electrolyser, two discharge compressors, one hydrogen gas storage tank, one 
bypass loop of generated hydrogen gas, one feed demiwater loop, and one hydrogen 
gas 
discharge bottles line.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mahmoud Saad Eldin Bakry, tested by eng. Waleed Mostafa Ahmed , revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abdel Menem Al-Emam, accepted by general director eng. Ibrahim 
Elsaid Abdel Hamed, and approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel Latef Mady: Ataka Power Station

This document 
accepted by
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& Financial 
quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This Document outlines the 
maintenance procedures 
P1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
The hydrogen producing unit function is to produce hydrogen gas by 
electrical analysis to demi-water.
The Hydrogen Production Unit consists of:: one hydrogen gas 
electrolyser, two discharge compressors, one hydrogen gas storage tank, one 
bypass loop of generated hydrogen gas, one feed demiwater loop, and one hydrogen 
gas 
discharge bottles line.
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mahmoud Saad Eldin Bakry, tested by eng. Waleed Mostafa Ahmed , revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abdel Menem Al-Emam, accepted by general director eng. Ibrahim 
Elsaid Abdel Hamed, and approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel Latef Mady: Ataka Power Station
This document 
accepted by
eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by 
accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; general director of Admin.& Financial 
quality control, and supervisor of EDEPC inspection & quality control Head 
sector.
Safety Precautions
A work order must be issued, the maintenance staff should be qualified and 
 carry the suitable safety ID category.
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, etc
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
The hydrogen producing unit must be out of service.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multi-meter.
Screw driver kit, manual tools
Oil spry cleaner & Teflon roll...
Pneumatic & Hydraulic Calibrators
External 24VDC power supply.
Temperature Calibrator
Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Obtain a copy of (level switches, pressure switches, temperature Switches, 
 solenoid valves) maintenance manuals
Obtain a copy of relay control circuit diagram of Hydrogen Producing unit
Release and Protection Test
Hydrogen Gas Electrolyser
Check pressure switch of suction pressure w.r.t MPIS doc PS-001-r0 and check this alarm on alarm window for Electrolyser.
Check pressure switch of discharge pressure w.r.t MPIS doc PS-001-r0 and check this alarm on alarm window.
Check the solenoid valve of feed demi-water to electrolyser.
Check the temperature switch of feed demi-water and check this alarm on alarm 
 window for Electrolyser.
Check level switches of hydrogen storage tank.
Check level switches of demi-water/ hydrogen for drum level and check this 
 alarm on alarm window.
Discharge Compressors
Check pressure switch of suction pressure of each discharge compressor w.r.t 
 MPIS doc PS-001-r0 and check this alarm 
 on alarm window.
Check pressure switch of 1st stage discharge pressure of each discharge 
 compressor w.r.t MPIS doc PS-001-r0 and check 
 this alarm on alarm window.
Check pressure switch of 2nd stage discharge pressure of each discharge 
 compressor w.r.t MPIS doc PS-001-r0 and check 
 this alarm on alarm window.
Check level switch of cooling water for each discharge compressor.
Check level switches of hydrogen storage tank.
The Hydrogen bypass Loop Check
Check the three ways of the solenoid valve in both manual mode and auto mode.
Check high level switch.
